The grandmother: a 71-year-old Black American woman with medium-deep brown skin and warm red-gold undertones. A round face with full cheeks, warm brown eyes, a broad soft nose and full lips; her skin has few deep wrinkles for her age: soft smile lines, gentle creases at the outer corners of her eyes, slightly deeper-toned skin under her eyes and a few tiny raised deep-brown spots on her upper cheeks, as many older Black women have. Short natural silver-white hair in tight coils, cut in a neat tapered shape, close at the sides and back and fuller on top. Reading glasses with thin gold frames hang on a fine chain against her chest; small gold stud earrings, a small gold cross necklace and a thin gold wedding band.
